title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
hook_text: Grok and OpenAI pick opposite parties
script:
XAI built Grok to overwhelmingly recommend Republican candidates in political races.
OpenAI designed GPT to favor Democrats instead.
A new study tested both models across nearly five hundred election races.
The two AI models disagreed in over ninety percent of those tests.
TechCrunch published the findings after examining how political bias shapes automated decision making.
Voters increasingly rely on conversational chatbots for election information and candidate research.
Would you trust an AI to pick your candidate?
